main--adj.ex: The main entrance is on this side.

fellow--noun.def: A man, or someone who belongs to the same group.
fellow--noun.ex: An old fellow sold us the tickets.
fellow--noun.exTr: Yaşlı bir adam bize biletleri sattı.

blind--adj.ex: He has been blind since birth.

hanging--adj.def: Attached at the top so that it hangs down.
hanging--adj.ex: A hanging lamp lit the table.

speed--verb.def: To move quickly, or to drive faster than allowed.
speed--verb.ex: The driver was fined for speeding.
speed--verb.exTr: Sürücüye hız yaptığı için ceza kesildi.

somehow--adv.def: In a way you cannot explain or do not know yet.

hearing--noun.def: The ability to hear, or a meeting in a court.
hearing--noun.ex: His hearing got worse with age.

account--verb.def: To explain something, or to form a part of a total.
account--verb.ex: Exports account for half our income.

tape--verb.def: To record sound or pictures, or to fasten with tape.

pardon--verb.def: To forgive someone, or to free them from punishment.

vote--verb.def: To choose someone or something in an election.

career--noun.def: The work a person does over many years.
career--noun.ex: She began her career as a nurse.

breath--noun.def: The air you take into your body and let out.
breath--noun.ex: Take a deep breath and relax.
breath--noun.exTr: Derin bir nefes al ve rahatla.

operation--noun.def: Medical treatment by cutting, or an organized action.
operation--noun.ex: She had an operation on her knee.

market--verb.def: To advertise and sell a product.
market--verb.ex: They market the tea in twelve countries.

monster--noun.def: A large frightening creature in stories.
monster--noun.ex: The film is about a sea monster.

loud--adv.def: In a way that makes a lot of noise.
loud--adv.ex: Do not play the music so loud.

horrible--adj.ex: The weather was horrible all week.

investigation--noun.def: An official attempt to find out the truth.

nonsense--noun.def: Ideas or words that have no sense at all.

doc--noun.def: An informal word for a doctor.

prepared--adj.def: Ready for something, or willing to do it.
prepared--adj.ex: We were not prepared for the cold.

incredible--adj.def: So surprising or good that it is hard to believe.

criminal--noun.def: A person who has broken the law.
criminal--noun.ex: The criminal was caught at the border.

honestly--adv.def: In a truthful way, or used to stress what you say.
honestly--adv.ex: Honestly, I did not like the film.

feed--verb.def: To give food to a person or an animal.
feed--verb.ex: She fed the cats at dawn.

nurse--verb.def: To look after someone who is ill.
nurse--verb.ex: He nursed his father for months.

fake--adj.def: Made to look real in order to trick people.
fake--adj.ex: The painting turned out to be fake.

suicide--noun.def: The act of killing oneself on purpose.
suicide--noun.ex: The helpline aims to prevent suicide.

concerned--adj.def: Worried about something, or involved in it.
concerned--adj.ex: Parents are concerned about the new rule.

view--verb.def: To look at something, or to think of it in a certain way.
view--verb.ex: They view the change as positive.

strike--verb.def: To hit something hard, or to happen suddenly.

nowhere--adv.def: In or to no place at all.
nowhere--adv.ex: The keys were nowhere to be found.

sheriff--noun.def: An elected police officer in an American county.

turning--noun.def: A place where a road goes off to one side.
turning--noun.ex: Take the second turning on the left.

recognize--verb.def: To know someone or something you have seen before.
recognize--verb.ex: I hardly recognized him with a beard.

jealous--adj.def: Unhappy because someone else has what you want.
jealous--adj.ex: He was jealous of her success.

finding--noun.def: A piece of information that research discovers.
finding--noun.ex: The report presents three main findings.

release--verb.def: To set someone free, or to make something available.
release--verb.ex: The band released a new album.

universe--noun.def: All of space and everything in it.

program--verb.def: To give a computer or a machine a set of instructions.
program--verb.ex: He programmed the heating to start early.

heat--verb.ex: Heat the oil in a wide pan.

aware--adj.def: Knowing that something exists or is happening.
aware--adj.ex: Are you aware of the new rules?

surely--adv.def: Used when you expect others to agree with you.
surely--adv.ex: Surely he told you about it.

male--adj.def: Belonging to the sex that does not give birth.
male--adj.ex: Most male birds have brighter colours.
male--adj.exTr: Erkek kuşların çoğu daha parlak renklidir.

base--verb.def: To build an idea or a decision on something.
base--verb.ex: The film is based on a true story.

lift--noun.def: A machine that carries people between floors, or a ride.
lift--noun.ex: Take the lift to the fifth floor.

lift--verb.def: To raise something to a higher position.
lift--verb.ex: Can you lift this box alone?
lift--verb.exTr: Bu kutuyu tek başına kaldırabilir misin?

lab--noun.def: A room where scientific tests are done.
lab--noun.ex: The samples are still in the lab.

command--noun.def: An order, or an instruction given to a computer.
command--noun.ex: The soldiers waited for the command.

proof--noun.def: Information that shows something is definitely true.
proof--noun.ex: We need proof of your address.

afford--verb.def: To have enough money or time for something.
afford--verb.ex: We cannot afford a new car.

total--adj.ex: The total cost was quite low.

total--noun.def: The number you get when you add everything.
total--noun.ex: The total came to nine hundred lira.

tie--verb.def: To fasten with string, or to finish a game equal.
tie--verb.ex: Tie the rope around the post.

opening--noun.def: A hole or gap, or the start of an event.
opening--noun.ex: We attended the opening of the museum.

bullet--noun.def: A small piece of metal fired from a gun.

lately--adv.ex: I have not seen her lately.

season--noun.def: One of the four parts of the year, or a period of activity.

distance--noun.def: The amount of space between two places.
distance--noun.ex: The distance is about ten kilometres.

responsibility--noun.def: A duty that you must deal with.
responsibility--noun.ex: Cleaning the lab is his responsibility.

whenever--adv.def: At any time that you like.
whenever--adv.ex: Call me whenever you need help.
whenever--adv.exTr: Yardıma ihtiyacın olduğunda ne zaman olursa ara.

process--noun.def: A series of steps that produce a result.
process--noun.ex: Learning a language is a slow process.

sword--noun.def: A long sharp weapon with a handle.
sword--noun.ex: The museum displays an old sword.

tiny--adj.ex: A tiny insect landed on the page.

property--noun.def: Something a person owns, or a quality of a material.
property--noun.ex: The property includes a large garden.
property--noun.exTr: Mülk büyük bir bahçeyi de kapsıyor.

settle--verb.def: To go and live somewhere, or to end an argument.
settle--verb.ex: They settled in Bursa after the war.

bite--verb.def: To cut into something with your teeth.

interview--verb.def: To ask someone questions for a job or a report.

surgery--noun.def: Medical treatment in which a doctor cuts the body.
surgery--noun.ex: He needs surgery on his shoulder.

mayor--noun.def: The elected leader of a city or a town.
mayor--noun.ex: The mayor opened the new library.

gentleman--noun.def: A polite word for a man.
gentleman--noun.ex: A gentleman is waiting at reception.

split--noun.def: A division into parts, or a break between people.
split--noun.ex: The split in the party surprised nobody.

alarm--verb.def: To make someone suddenly worried or frightened.
alarm--verb.ex: The news alarmed the whole village.

model--adj.def: Serving as a perfect example of something.
model--adj.ex: It is a model school for the region.

model--verb.def: To make a copy of a system, or to display clothes.
model--verb.ex: Scientists modelled the spread of the disease.

finger--noun.def: One of the five parts at the end of your hand.
finger--noun.ex: She cut her finger on the glass.

access--noun.def: The right or the chance to use something.
access--noun.ex: Students have access to the archive.

flat--adj.def: Level and smooth, with no high parts.
